subject: English Home Language

source.topic: People who help us: Emergent Writing
source.subtopic: Letter formation of 'p' and 't' (walking large chalk letters, pipe-cleaner and plasticine letters)

show.line: Let's write p and t. p has a long tail and a round tummy. t is tall with a cross.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says p, as in police.
Trace p with your finger. A long line down, then back up and round.
Tap the letter that says t, as in teacher.
Trace t with your finger. A tall line down, then a line across.
Point to p. What sound does it make?

hints: p has a tail that hangs down. t is tall with a cross.
Start at the top. Go down first.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write t for teacher.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: A tall line down. Look, I wrote t!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is l. t needs a line across.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Tall line down, then across. That is t!

parent_line: Can recognise the letters p and t, say their sounds and trace them.
